question: Estimate the number of insurance agents in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: LIC + private life + general insurance + health insurance individual agents combined? All licensed agents.
Active agents (commission earned in past year)? Active.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Private life insurers (HDFC Life, ICICI Pru, Max, SBI Life, etc.)
General insurers (ICICI Lombard, Bajaj Allianz, etc.) agents
Plus PoS (Point of Sale) agents licensed for simpler products

calculationFlow: LIC of India agents: ~13.5 lakh (largest single agent force globally).
Private life insurers (HDFC Life, ICICI Pru, Max, SBI Life, etc.): ~10 lakh combined.
General insurers (ICICI Lombard, Bajaj Allianz, etc.) agents: ~3 lakh.
Health insurance specialists + independent advisors: ~2 lakh.
Plus PoS (Point of Sale) agents licensed for simpler products: ~3 lakh additional.
Total active agents: ~28-30 lakh; total licensed (incl. dormant): ~40 lakh.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Total active agents: ~28-30 lakh; total licensed (incl. dormant): ~40 lakh.
